Gotchas: use withr::with_seed (declared in Suggests); testthat::with_seed is not exported. The shuffle wrapper takes exactly (Dmat, dvec, Amat, bvec, meq), so a new argument in the production solve.QP() call fails loudly. A constant an existing test reads must be defined above that test (a test file runs top to bottom). test_markerKinship.R’s runtime benchmark can fail on a loaded machine: rerun it alone before suspecting a change. pgrep -f wait loops fire early (Learning 864): wait on the job’s own marker line. rm -f $VAR/*.R is blocked by the safety check.
